report:
Reviewed the complete body_independence claim, the single ordinary implementation association in local_syms/fns.rs, and the complete sole test sage_meta::todo::checking_signature_body_independence. Baseline verification: both fns.rs and semantic_spec.rs exactly match the historical input snapshots, independently compared against current files. The captured historical report provides genuine claim-specific source reasoning; this assessment independently checked the current fragments and retains its limited TODO conclusion.

Fresh source evidence: LocalFnSym::sig constructs a Stashed<Binder<FnSig>> containing owner and method generics, parameter and return types, and the completed parameter environment. open_owner requests trait/impl signatures and imports their interface facts. The visible sig body lowers declaration types and predicates and finishes the binder without accessing cst.body or calling body checking. The separate body query requests sig, imports its interface, and only then reads/checks cst.body. These observations support the intended interface separation, but do not establish transitive absence of body dependencies for every signature query or local/external consumer.

The sole annotated test is explicitly TODO and has no behavioral assertions. Its comment specifically defers query traces for both local and external callers proving dependence on selected interface facts and no bodies, plus a body-only edit retaining the signature result without reexecuting consumers. This is a justified verification gap covering the universal no-body requirement and consumer independence; prerequisites are representative local/external caller fixtures, dependency/execution trace observations, and an incremental body-only mutation scenario with stable signature/consumer assertions. Merely opening the owning CST in sig does not prove body-edit reuse. No claim of complete implementation or test adequacy is made; the accepted TODO remains visible. No additional helper behavior is assumed in reaching this limited assessment.

Execution: ran review start and independent exact-byte baseline comparison; inspected all current initial fragments and metadata. No behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported build and suite results are separate execution evidence and do not discharge the TODO. No source edits or additional edits requested.
